body:
ARENA_MAP_SCALE_9X (3.0) applied on top of the existing golden-ratio scale-up to ARENA_HALF_EXTENT, plus every non-derived spatial literal (node/obstacle/lane/powerup layouts). ARENA_NODE_COUNT 5->9 with 4 new Outpost nodes at real midpoints. Ability ranges/speeds deliberately unscaled. 1 new test, 2 pre-existing tests fixed for real behavior changes, 1200 PASS, zero regressions. commit e396bdc.

⚓ ☃
title: Map grown 9x (3x linear) with 4 new capturable nodes
